capabilities: Export the current note to PDF from the ribbon, command palette, or menus
Configure page size, orientation, margins, and downscaling
Add headers and footers with tokens for title, page numbers, dates, and properties
Print multi-column exam cheat sheets with compact or continuous layout
Save and restore export settings as a pagina-settings.json file
extras: Desktop only; mobile export is disabled until reliable. The README notes the image-based export cannot be fully tagged for accessibility. Includes a Star history section, suggesting a GitHub repository.
problem: Obsidian's built-in export gives limited control over page layout, headers, footers, and multi-column printing.
summary: PDF export tool that prints the open note to PDF on desktop with configurable page size, margins, headers, footers, and layout options.
